value.description: The amended ceiling in the pending proposal.

was.description: The prior value the confirmation shows as "(was …)" (adapters/governance.py:110-115).

claimId.description: A claim identifier, the one claim-id pattern (shared-defs claimId); the terminal consent names a status the same way (core/evaluation.py:495-501).

configurationAmendment.description: The human amendment the confirm-edited form confirms: ceilings only, the decision payload's own amendment shape (empirica/v2 request.schema.json governanceDecisionPayload.amendment) with each ceiling's prior value (the "(was …)" the form renders).

configurationBudget.description: One budget row exactly as the dialog builds it (core/projection.py governance_dialog, budgets from governance.CEILINGS, core/governance.py:46-47; the shared dialog shape empirica/v2 shared-defs governancePresentation.dialog.budgets).

then.description: A confirm-edited document names the amendment it confirms.
An approve form confirms no amendment.

configurationDocument.description: What the "approve run configuration" and "confirm edited configuration" forms ask (ADR-0063, ADR-0072): the whole sizing case — goal, rationale, every budget with used and bounds, the amendment and its priors on a confirm-edited form.

budgets.description: Every ceiling in the dialog's order; the dialog is built from governance.CEILINGS so the row set is exactly these three (core/projection.py governance_dialog).

goal.description: The run's goal in full — the form's first line, the document's whole text (the dialog goal, shared-defs governancePresentation.dialog.goal).

governance_state.description: Which question it is, by the core's own state word (the dialog's state, empirica/v2 shared-defs governancePresentation.dialog; core/governance.py:139, HUMAN_WAIT_STATES :189): pending is the "approve run configuration" form, revision_pending the "confirm edited configuration" form (adapters/governance.py:95,118).

plan_revision.description: The dialog's epoch (the core's plan_revision, core/projection.py governance_dialog; each amendment bumps it, core/governance.py revise:128-146).

proposal_digest.description: The proposal the decision binds (governance proposal_digest, bound again by the governance decision payload).

rationale.description: The sizing rationale moved here wholesale (the form renders all of it today, adapters/governance.py:88-93); null when the proposal carries none. Shape copied from the dialog's rationale (shared-defs governancePresentation.dialog.rationale).

run_id.description: The run the decisions name (the decision payloads' run_id).

contextWhenShown.description: NOT part of the decision (ADR-0072): what the dialog stood beside when it was shown. Recorded so the document says its context, excluded so it can change without changing what is being approved.

budgets_used.description: Each ceiling's used count at showing time (the dialog budgets' used, core/projection.py governance_dialog; the state's used keys, core/governance.py:46-47).

reviews_left.description: The human interactions left (the dialog reviews_left, core/governance.py interactions_remaining:168-177).

digest256.description: A sha256 content digest, the same pattern every other empirica/v2 schema uses (shared-defs digest256; core/canonical.py:34-37).

evidenceClaim.description: One claim of the batch with its text — the item text that moves out of the form (adapters/confirmation.py:131-134); id, wording digest and text from the argument view's claim row (core/projection.py:566-573).

claim_digest.description: The claim's wording digest, binding id and text (core/evaluation.py claim_digest:277-280).

then.description: The terminal consent is one decision on one item: it holds nothing else (core/evaluation.py terminal_batch:495-501).

evidenceDocument.description: What the end-of-pass evidence batch asks, and the terminal consent: every record with its quote, class and why-no-spike reason, and every claim with its text (ADR-0067, ADR-0072).

claims.description: The batch's waiting decisions first, in graph order (core/evaluation.py confirmation_batch).

key.description: The batch's key — derivations and exactly the shown items (core/evaluation.py confirmation_batch:549-561; the terminal batch's own key, terminal_key:486-492) — the value the evidence presentation payload carries.

records.description: The batch's records, in their claim's graph order then submission (core/evaluation.py confirmation_batch).

run_id.description: The run the presentation and the confirmation name (the evidence payloads' run_id).

evidenceRecord.description: One research record of the batch, from the argument view's research artifacts (core/projection.py:576-591) as the items builder reads them (adapters/confirmation.py build_items:136-155); the confirmation artifact body's own record_id word (core/evaluation.py:1029-1035).

citation.description: The quote a human confirms or rejects (the research payload's citation; the only record fact the form keeps).

claim_digest.description: The claim wording the record is bound to (the argument artifact's claim_digest).

record_id.description: The record's artifact id (the argument artifact_id; the batch's record_ids).

source_kind.description: The record's immutable source kind (the research payload's source_kind, empirica/v2 public-contract.json:584-590).

source_ref.description: Where the record's fact comes from (the research payload's source_ref).

spike_unavailable.description: Why no deterministic check can establish the record (the research payload's spike_unavailable; empirica/v2 public-contract.json:618-620) — the "why no spike" reason that moves out of the form (adapters/confirmation.py:153-155).

verification_class.description: How the record is verified, derived from source_ref (core/citations.py verification_class:66-73): null when no class can be derived.

invocationFacts.description: The neutral invocation facts the dialog shows (INVOCATION_FACTS, core/projection.py:297-303; shared-defs invocationProvenance; types copied from the state schema's invocation, empirica/v2 state.schema.json:755-877).

terminalConsent.description: The terminal "end this run without converging" consent (ADR-0063's amendment, ADR-0072): the batch terminal member (core/evaluation.py terminal_batch:495-501) with what ending now would leave unresolved.

digest.description: The consent's wording digest (the terminal batch's terminal.digest, core/evaluation.py terminal_batch).

residuals.description: What ending now leaves unresolved: the run obligation rows as the run view projects them, id and required line (core/projection.py _obligation:139-147; report_requirements, core/evaluation.py:1408-1480).

status.description: The status the run would end as (TERMINAL_STATUSES, core/evaluation.py:456).

description: Source-tree schema (not vendored into the plugin; ADR-0072) of the core-owned immutable JSON document a human decides on: what the native forms moved out and the record binds by its digest. The bytes are pinned by the contract validator: json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) plus one trailing newline, UTF-8; the document_digest is the SHA-256 of exactly those bytes. Field names and types are derived from the builders that render this content today, cited per field. The document is a pure function of run state: no wall-clock times and nothing the adapter chooses (a receipt id the host generates is never here).
title: Empirica v2 human-in-the-loop document (empirica.hitl/1)
